PART 3 — TERMS AND CONDITIONS

3.1 I agree to the terms of Loan in accordance with the repayment schedule of Moroma Finance Ltd and thus I accept the above stated loan amount.

3.2 I agree to repay the Loan on fortnightly instalments without defaulting during the period of the loan repayment.

3.3 I agree that any defaults incurred will result in overdue charges amounting to 25% of the fortnightly rate and I must settle all outstanding arrears that accumulate.

3.4 I authorize direct debit of my bank account by Standing Order Authority or Payroll Deduction by my employer the fortnightly repayment amount due and credited to Moroma Finance Ltd Deduction Code {{ bank_config.alesco_dc|default:settings.ALESCO_DC }} or to its {{ bank_config.bank }} {{ bank_config.bank_branch }} Branch Cheque Account No. {{ bank_config.bank_acc_num }}.

3.5 I agree that I will make withdrawals from my Salary Accounts after how much I agree to pay fortnightly to Moroma Finance Ltd is effected.

3.6 I agree that term reference in 3.3 (above) also applies on the difference of the reduced amount paid for loan repayment per pay period ending.

3.7 I agree that I will offset any outstanding balance of this loan from the proceeds of my Superannuation Fund Contributions, savings at Bank, property rental income and elsewhere and or Finish pay entitlements to Moroma Finance Ltd, should I be terminated or made redundant or death.

3.8 I agree that I will notify Moroma Finance Ltd immediately of any change in my employment status and / or bank account.

3.9 I as a public sector worker agree to repay the loan amount and any fees and charges in full without tempering the established deduction.

3.10 I understand that my loan application will be rejected if my application form is not properly filled and necessary documents are not provided, and

3.11 I have read and understood every particulars of the loan and do accept the Terms and Conditions (of the Loan) as stated in the aforesaid application.
